_meta.paper: Patton, A.J. (2011) 'Volatility Forecast Comparison Using Imperfect Volatility Proxies', Journal of Econometrics, 160(1), pp. 246-256
_meta.equation: Eq. (5): QLIKE(sigma2, h) = log(h) + sigma2/h (robust loss function for volatility forecast evaluation)
_meta.note: Implementation clips at [-10, 10] for overflow protection; equivalent within this range

perfect_forecast.expected_per_obs: log(h) + sigma2/h = log(h) + 1 for each obs
perfect_forecast.note: QLIKE is minimized when predicted = actual (each term = log(h_i) + 1)

hand_calculation.note: Mean QLIKE across observations is reported; minimum is at h=sigma2

minimum_property.description: For any actual sigma2, QLIKE is minimized when h = sigma2. Proof: d/dh [log(h) + sigma2/h] = 1/h - sigma2/h^2 = 0 => h = sigma2
minimum_property.test_approach: Generate predictions with small perturbation around truth; verify QLIKE increases

asymmetry_property.description: Under-prediction (h < sigma2) is penalized more heavily than over-prediction (h > sigma2) of the same magnitude. This follows from the convexity of sigma2/h.
asymmetry_property.test_approach: Compare QLIKE(sigma2, sigma2-epsilon) vs QLIKE(sigma2, sigma2+epsilon)
